name: Lunar New Year
tagline: Red lanterns, plum blossoms and good-fortune celebrations.
description: Spring Festival portraits in the Chinese New Year tradition: lantern-lined streets, red envelopes, dumpling folding, plum blossoms, lion dances, reunion dinners, temple fairs, tea and mandarin oranges. Silk qipao and Tang-style jackets in lucky red and gold.
